notes: In Mexico, 'penoso' is also very commonly used in everyday speech to mean shy or easily embarrassed.

senses.definition: Of a person or their behavior: nervous and uncomfortable around other people, or lacking confidence.

examples.text: De niño, él era muy tímido y no quería hablar con extraños.
examples.translation: As a child, he was very shy and did not want to talk to strangers.
examples.emotion: gentle and reflective, looking back on an earlier time

draftBefore.emotion: reserved and slightly unsure, holding back just a little
notes: Use 'tímido' for someone who is generally shy. It is different from 'vergonzoso', which describes someone who is easily embarrassed or feels shame.

senses.definition: Nervous or uncomfortable in the company of other people.

examples.text: De niño, él era muy tímido y no quería hablar con extraños.
examples.translation: As a child, he was very shy and did not want to talk to strangers.
examples.emotion: gentle and reflective, looking back on an earlier time

senses.definition: Showing a lack of confidence or hesitation in action.

examples.text: Dio un paso tímido hacia la puerta.
examples.translation: He took a hesitant step toward the door.
examples.emotion: cautious and observant, focused on a small movement

faults.quote: Showing a lack of confidence or hesitation in action.
faults.why: A timid person and a timid action are shades of one meaning.

faults.quote: It is different from 'vergonzoso', which describes someone who is easily embarrassed
